name: blueprint/author-watch
description: Follow an author's new papers: query the keyless arXiv API, diff by id, summarise the new ones, store the window
ingredients: arXiv Atom adapter (paper-digest recipe, live-probed keyless)
recipe: query arXiv by author (plus a category filter when names collide) -> diff the window by arxiv id -> summarise only the new papers -> store + notify once
pitfalls: author names are ambiguous - pair with a category or affiliation filter
diff by arxiv id, never by title (titles get revised)
summarise new papers only - never re-digest the window
